commits.message:
feat(plugins): add continuous monitoring and blocking to version control plugin

- Add continuous polling mechanism to detect server changes every 60 seconds
- Implement tool_pre_invoke hook to block calls when pending versions exist
- Add status field to ServerVersion model (active/pending/deactivated)
- Add check_for_changes() method to detect tool modifications
- Add approve_version() and deactivate_version() for version lifecycle
- Switch plugin mode from permissive to enforce for blocking behavior
- Add VC_DATABASE_URL environment variable to docker-compose.yml
- Update plugin config to use environment variable templates
- Add test scripts for manual testing and blocking verification
- Add debug script for hash computation troubleshooting

This transforms the version control plugin from a one-time backfill on
startup to an active monitoring system that continuously tracks server
changes and enforces approval workflows before allowing tool execution.
commits.author: Calvin Wong Shao Tzun

commits.message:
feat(version-control): implement real-time change detection in tool pre-hook

- Add real-time server backfilling when new servers are detected on first tool call
- Implement immediate change detection before each tool invocation
- Create pending versions in DB when changes are detected (not just via polling)
- Deactivate old versions when new pending versions are created
- Add comprehensive debug logging to troubleshoot hook execution
- Ensure database is updated before tool calls, preventing race conditions
commits.author: Nachiketh Janapareddy
